scope.purpose: Web reference audit only. This file does not authorize copying, tracing, extracting, or redistributing official art.

classificationDefinitions.CANON_REFERENCE: The exact named chassis or its explicitly documented product family exists in released Alien-franchise material. Art must preserve the published identity; family-only references remain blocked until a variant is chosen.
classificationDefinitions.PROJECT_ADAPTATION: The exact runtime chassis is not attested, but it adapts a documented vehicle, object, faction, corporation, location, or cancelled franchise concept. It must be labeled as a project adaptation.
classificationDefinitions.PROJECT_ORIGINAL: No reliable external match for the named chassis was found. The name and silhouette are project continuity and must not be presented as franchise canon.

sourcePolicy: Prefer 20th Century Studios, SEGA, and Free League product pages as primary publication anchors.
Use documented secondary indexes for vehicle-specific names and dimensions when no public primary specification page exists.
A cancelled draft or game is a non-canon production reference, never proof of released continuity.
Search-result absence is not proof of non-existence; PROJECT_ORIGINAL means no reliable exact match was located in this audit.

globalArtContract.copyright: Create a new project-owned bitmap. Do not copy, trace, photobash, crop, vectorize, or repaint an official still, prop photograph, concept sheet, game capture, book illustration, logo, or fan asset.
globalArtContract.sidePerspective: Strict gameplay side view, vehicle facing right, orthographic or near-orthographic. Yaw may not exceed 8 degrees and may only expose functional depth. No cinematic three-quarter view, fisheye, top-down, or front view.
globalArtContract.metroidvaniaReadability: Entire chassis visible and unclipped on transparent alpha, with breathing room. Contact points share one ground, rail, or water datum. Cockpit and doors must establish human scale at gameplay zoom.
globalArtContract.lighting: Single restrained upper-left key, readable shadow groups, no environment, floor, cast-shadow plate, bloom wall, or atmospheric backdrop.
globalArtContract.markings: Use only diegetic era/faction markings supported by the entry. New serial numbers must be project-original. No modern real-world branding, poster typography, UI labels, watermark, or copied studio/game logo.
globalArtContract.redesignBan: Do not merge unrelated chassis, add fashionable wings/wheels/weapons, smooth away industrial structure, or turn utilitarian retro-future hardware into a sleek contemporary supercar/jet.

entries.recommendedName: Resolve as M570 Series APC or M570 All-Terrain Transport
entries.verdict: The current entry hybridizes two published lineages: older technical-manual continuity identifies an M570 All-Terrain Transport/prime mover distinct from the M577, while the Alien RPG core identifies an M570 Series APC with the M577 as its standard model. The current APC noun plus seats=8 does not cleanly resolve either branch.

sources.use: Official licensed Alien RPG publication anchor for the Evolved core vehicle line.
Documents the M577 as the standard model in the M570 series.
Documents the older M570 All-Terrain Transport identity distinct from M577.

strictInvariants.silhouette: Series-APC branch: low broad four-wheel armored wedge with sliding/stowable main weapon lineage. ATT branch: a land-based prime mover/cargo transport distinct from M577; its own reference silhouette must be secured before art.
strictInvariants.proportions: Series-APC branch: about 9.2 m and 13 published passengers, full-squad volume. ATT branch: do not import the APC dimensions or M577 proportions; seats=8 is not evidence for the Series-APC branch.
strictInvariants.sidePerspective: Right-facing orthographic side view with all contacts on one datum; render only the selected branch and use a stowed main weapon only for the Series-APC lineage.
strictInvariants.metroidvania: Selected branch must show driver station, access/cargo function, running gear, and human scale distinctly; the ATT cannot read as a duplicate combat APC.
strictInvariants.markings: Restrained USCM/UA military stencil language and an original hull serial; no copied Sulaco APC nose art.

forbiddenRedesign: Do not combine the older M570 ATT name/capacity with the Alien RPG M570 Series APC silhouette.
Do not add tracks, extra axles, or a modern remote weapon station without a selected variant source.
Do not invent a unique M570 silhouette while calling it canon.
requiredCorrections: Choose one branch: M570 Series APC, M570 All-Terrain Transport, or merge/remove the duplicate.

For M570 Series APC, replace seats=8 with published passengers=13 and choose a weapon configuration distinct from the existing M577; for M570 ATT, rename and re-source its prime-mover geometry/capacity before art.
Replace the global licensed-reference claim with a family-level reference note.

entries.verdict: The chassis is attested, but its full name is M40 Ridgeway Heavy Tank and published crew is 2–3, not 4.

sources.use: Vehicle-specific name, dimensions, crew, armament, and amphibious role.

strictInvariants.silhouette: Heavy tracked combat hull with a substantial rear-biased turret and dominant 115 mm cannon; separate smaller defensive system.
strictInvariants.proportions: Approximately 9.77 m long; broad armored mass, low ground clearance, turret visibly smaller than hull but not APC-like.
strictInvariants.sidePerspective: Strict right-facing side profile with complete tracks and cannon in a neutral near-horizontal travel pose.
strictInvariants.metroidvania: Track run, turret ring, main cannon, and crew-scale hatch must separate cleanly at gameplay zoom.
strictInvariants.markings: USCM/United States military stencil grammar, muted armor panels, original tactical number.

forbiddenRedesign: Do not reuse the M577 wheeled wedge.
Do not substitute the later M40-E silhouette without renaming the entry.
Do not turn the 115 mm cannon into twin sci-fi barrels or a railgun.
requiredCorrections: Rename to M40 Ridgeway Heavy Tank.
Change seats/crew from 4 to 2–3.
Keep M40 and M40-E as distinct variants.

entries.recommendedName: M292 Self-Propelled Artillery — A2 only if laser CIWS is selected
entries.verdict: Critical conflict: M292 denotes a six-crew heavy tracked self-propelled artillery system with a 158 mm howitzer, never a light combat buggy. M292A2 is the air-defense-laser variant and must not be assumed unless that CIWS is depicted.

sources.use: Official licensed manual anchor for M292/M292A2 self-propelled artillery.

strictInvariants.silhouette: Long armored tracked artillery chassis dominated by one 158 mm howitzer; protected six-crew volume, with roof laser CIWS only on A2.
strictInvariants.proportions: Approximately 11.1 m and 38-ton visual mass; gun length must dominate the vehicle and overhang the forward hull; no exposed buggy frame.
strictInvariants.sidePerspective: Right-facing orthographic artillery profile, complete track run, gun in low neutral travel/elevation pose.
strictInvariants.metroidvania: The single huge gun, track silhouette, crew hatch, and rear machinery must read instantly as self-propelled artillery.
strictInvariants.markings: USCM artillery unit stencils and original hull serial; no sports/racing numbers.

forbiddenRedesign: Absolutely no buggy, bike, open roll cage, or lightweight four-wheel silhouette.
Do not preserve seats=3: the documented M292 crew is 6.
Do not confuse the M292 designation with a fictional fast-attack model.
requiredCorrections: Rename and redesign as M292 Self-Propelled Artillery, selecting M292A2 only if its laser CIWS is included; otherwise give the buggy a completely new project designation.
Replace seats=3 with documented crew=6 for the artillery branch.
Treat this as a P0 lore/data correction before art generation.

entries.verdict: The P-5000 Powered Work Loader is exact canon reference; Combat Power Loader is not a stable model name. A militarized version is an adaptation unless renamed to a specifically documented exosuit variant.

sources.use: Official film page includes the Power Loader as visual reference.
P-5000 identity, function, one-pilot arrangement, and variants.

strictInvariants.silhouette: Open one-pilot anthropomorphic loader frame, tall biped legs, overhead roll cage, long hydraulic lifting arms.
strictInvariants.proportions: Human pilot visibly enclosed by the frame; arms longer and heavier than the pilot; broad stabilizing feet.
strictInvariants.sidePerspective: Right-facing orthographic side stance, both feet sharing one ground datum, arms in safe lowered gameplay pose.
strictInvariants.metroidvania: Pilot, cage, arm joints, claws, and feet must remain separately readable; compact enough for a character-scale traversal lane.
strictInvariants.markings: Industrial safety blocks and restrained USCM retrofit stencils; original serials only.

forbiddenRedesign: Do not close it into a power-armored humanoid suit.
Do not copy the Aliens loader frame line-for-line.
Do not add oversized shoulder missiles or anime-mecha anatomy.
requiredCorrections: Mark as project adaptation, not licensed-reference exact art.
If exact canon is desired, rename to P-5000 Powered Work Loader and remove unsupported combat equipment.

entries.recommendedName: UA Northridge UD-4B Cheyenne production model
entries.verdict: UD-4B is the initial Cheyenne production model: eight passengers plus flight crew fits the current total of 10. It is shorter and less armed than later UD-4 variants and cannot carry an M577.

sources.use: Official licensed publication anchor for Cheyenne variants.
Exact UD-4B variant specifications and distinguishing features.

strictInvariants.silhouette: Compact Cheyenne lineage with blunt cockpit, high shoulder nacelles, short fuselage, and landing gear; no standard nose gun.
strictInvariants.proportions: About 24.8 m in the RPG reference, visibly shorter/cleaner than later cargo-capable Cheyennes; cabin sized for eight passengers.
strictInvariants.sidePerspective: Right-facing orthographic landed profile, wings/nacelles not foreshortened into a frontal V.
strictInvariants.metroidvania: Cockpit, passenger hatch, nacelles, and gear must read as four separate functional groups.
strictInvariants.markings: Early UA Northridge/USCM or documented civilian-paramilitary livery; original tail code.

forbiddenRedesign: Do not add the later nose gun or secondary deployable weapon arrays as standard.
Do not give it an M577-sized cargo bay.
Do not copy the film UD-4L paint/nose art onto this earlier model.
requiredCorrections: Describe seats as 2 flight crew plus 8 passengers.
Keep UD-4B distinct from UD-4L/UD-4C.

entries.recommendedName: UA Northridge AD-19C/D Bearcat VTOL Strikeship
entries.verdict: The attested designation is AD-19C/D Bearcat VTOL Strikeship, not AD-19CD Dropship. C and D have different cabins: crew 2 versus 4; optional medivac panniers do not turn it into a 12-seat dropship.

sources.use: Official licensed manual lists the AD-19C/D Bearcat.
Exact model family, compact dimensions, crew variants, and armament.

strictInvariants.silhouette: Very compact roughly 8.8 m VTOL strike craft, twin turbofans, short armed nose, tight crew cabin.
strictInvariants.proportions: Fighter-like footprint rather than troop transport; C cabin fits two, D cabin fits four; optional underslung medivac panniers stay visibly external.
strictInvariants.sidePerspective: Right-facing orthographic landed/hover profile with both turbofans readable, no dramatic bank.
strictInvariants.metroidvania: Cockpit, twin lift fans, landing structure, nose gun, and optional pannier must remain distinct at small scale.
strictInvariants.markings: USCM strike-squadron stencils and original tail/side number.

forbiddenRedesign: Do not stretch it into a 12-seat dropship.
Do not merge C and D cabin geometries without selecting a variant.
Do not replace the twin-fan compact profile with a Cheyenne silhouette.
requiredCorrections: Rename to AD-19C Bearcat or AD-19D Bearcat and identify it as VTOL Strikeship.
Change capacity to crew 2 for C or crew 4 for D; track six wounded separately only if medivac panniers are equipped.
Block art until C or D is chosen.

entries.verdict: UA 571-C is a tripod-mounted automated sentry gun, not a vehicle or carrier. A mobile two-seat carrier can exist only as a project retrofit with the canon sentry visibly detachable.

sources.use: Official film-continuity anchor for the sentry system.
Exact sentry identity and tripod form.

strictInvariants.silhouette: Small low utility carrier carrying a recognizable detachable UA 571-C tripod gun; operator cabin remains secondary.
strictInvariants.proportions: Payload gun and folded tripod must retain portable-equipment scale; carrier cannot grow to APC/tank mass.
strictInvariants.sidePerspective: Right-facing orthographic ground profile with wheels/tracks and the sentry mount on one clear datum.
strictInvariants.metroidvania: Separate carrier, mounting cradle, ammo/power pack, and detachable sentry silhouette.
strictInvariants.markings: USCM logistics stencils plus a clear project retrofit serial; never imply an official UA model number for the carrier.

forbiddenRedesign: Do not call the mobile chassis itself UA 571-C.
Do not turn the sentry into a tank turret.
Do not hide the tripod/payload identity inside an armored hull.
requiredCorrections: Change provenance to project adaptation.
Name the mobile platform independently and reserve UA 571-C for its payload.

entries.verdict: The named shuttle is Narcissus, a modified Lockmart Starcub Light Intrasystem Shuttle and Nostromo lifeboat. Standard crew is three with two stasis capsules; it is not a seven-seat crew shuttle.

sources.use: Exact name, class, dimensions, crew, stasis, and propulsion layout.

strictInvariants.silhouette: Broad flattened lifeboat/shuttle with a compact central cabin, twin forward and four rear thrust tunnels, and folding tricycle gear.
strictInvariants.proportions: Approximately 21.3 m long by 16.2 m wide by 7 m high; notably broad rather than needle-shaped.
strictInvariants.sidePerspective: Right-facing orthographic free-flight or landed profile; preserve broad cabin mass without fake perspective foreshortening.
strictInvariants.metroidvania: Cockpit glazing, lifeboat cabin, forward/rear thrust apertures, docking interface, and gear read cleanly.
strictInvariants.markings: Narcissus and 1809-E1 may be referenced only as diegetic identity; render lettering freshly and avoid tracing film graphics.

forbiddenRedesign: Do not call it USCSS Nostromo as if the shuttle shares the tug's ship prefix/name.
Do not make it a seven-person airliner or sleek fighter.
Do not copy the filming miniature or its texture map.
requiredCorrections: Rename to Narcissus — Nostromo lifeboat.
Change seats from 7 to standard crew 3; track two stasis capsules separately.
Keep sister shuttle Salmacis out of this slot unless explicitly selected.

entries.recommendedName: Lander One — Class E Lander-Type Drop Shuttle
entries.verdict: The Covenant vehicle has a proper name and class: Lander One, Class E Lander-Type Drop Shuttle. Its documented complement is one pilot, one copilot, and ten passengers.

sources.use: Exact vehicle name, class, dimensions, and complement.

strictInvariants.silhouette: Large utilitarian Class E drop shuttle with broad central cabin, heavy landing gear, dorsal/side machinery, and clear loading access.
strictInvariants.proportions: Approximately 38 m overall; cabin scale must support twelve persons total and read larger than the Narcissus or AD-19.
strictInvariants.sidePerspective: Right-facing orthographic landed profile, full gear visible and hull unclipped.
strictInvariants.metroidvania: Cockpit, passenger module, engines, landing legs, and entry ramp must remain readable as discrete masses.
strictInvariants.markings: Covenant mission/Weyland-Yutani-era diegetic grammar and an original asset serial; no copied hull texture.

forbiddenRedesign: Do not compress it into an eight-seat light shuttle.
Do not call the lander itself USCSS Covenant.
Do not turn it into a military gunship.
requiredCorrections: Rename to Lander One — Class E Lander-Type Drop Shuttle.
Change capacity from 8 to 12 total: 2 flight crew plus 10 passengers.

entries.verdict: The film vehicle is the Weyland RT Series Group Transport, also called the Rover/RT01. Standard personnel bay capacity is up to 20 passengers plus driver; an open-bed variant carries the NR-9.

sources.use: Exact family name, eight-wheel chassis, configurations, and personnel capacity.

strictInvariants.silhouette: Massive elongated eight-wheel enclosed transport, four wheels per side, high armored industrial cabin, blunt ends.
strictInvariants.proportions: Long wheelbase and personnel bay dominate; wheels are large but do not swallow the tall rectangular body; driver scale makes it bus/APC-sized.
strictInvariants.sidePerspective: Strict right-facing side view showing all four visible wheels; no front-biased cinematic angle.
strictInvariants.metroidvania: Four-wheel rhythm, forward driver glazing, long personnel bay, doors, and roof equipment must survive sprite reduction.
strictInvariants.markings: Weyland Corp expedition-era utility markings and original RT unit serial; no copied prop decals.

forbiddenRedesign: Do not reduce it to a six-seat SUV.
Do not use the open-bed NR-9 carrier configuration while depicting a closed personnel cabin.
Do not reuse the M577 wedge.
requiredCorrections: Rename to RT Series Group Transport / RT01.
Change passenger capacity from 6 to up to 20, with driver tracked separately.
Select closed personnel or open-bed carrier configuration before art.

entries.recommendedName: NR-9 Series All Terrain Vehicle / EUV01
entries.verdict: The small Prometheus ATV is the NR-9 Series All Terrain Vehicle, also identified as EUV01/ATV NR6 in production references. It carries two people back-to-back, not four.

sources.use: Exact name, compact scale, seating, and distinctive wheel system.

strictInvariants.silhouette: Tiny open survey ATV with two occupants back-to-back, roll cage, and four distinctive tri-bogie track-belted wheel units.
strictInvariants.proportions: About 3.2 m long; human bodies dominate the chassis and establish its much smaller scale than the RT transport.
strictInvariants.sidePerspective: Right-facing orthographic profile; four contact units aligned, both opposite-facing seats legible.
strictInvariants.metroidvania: Roll cage, two seats, controls, and unusual wheel/belt system must not collapse into a generic quad bike.
strictInvariants.markings: Minimal Weyland Corp survey labeling with new unit serial.

forbiddenRedesign: Do not add a second row of seats.
Do not replace the tri-bogie belt wheels with ordinary tires or tank tracks.
Do not enlarge it into a conventional rover cabin.
requiredCorrections: Rename to NR-9 Series All Terrain Vehicle / EUV01.
Change seats from 4 to 2.

entries.verdict: Sevastopol has Towerlink passenger transit cars in pressurized tubes. No exact Seegson model called Maintenance Tram was located; this must be a maintenance conversion, not a claimed canon chassis.

sources.use: Official SEGA Alien: Isolation publication anchor.

strictInvariants.silhouette: Short enclosed tube-transit car converted for service, with blunt cab ends, side access, tool lockers, and maintenance couplers.
strictInvariants.proportions: Towerlink-derived passenger-car envelope; service conversion reduces seating and adds equipment without becoming a locomotive.
strictInvariants.sidePerspective: Right-facing orthographic rail/tube profile; wheel/guide interface aligned to one rail datum.
strictInvariants.metroidvania: Cab windows, side doors, service panels, coupler, and tube-clearance envelope must read at gameplay scale.
strictInvariants.markings: Seegson/Towerlink maintenance color blocking, caution bars, and an original service-car number.

forbiddenRedesign: Do not claim Maintenance Tram as an exact canonical model.
Do not call Towerlink a maglev without evidence.
Do not turn it into a terrestrial subway or bullet train.
requiredCorrections: Mark as project adaptation.
Separate this service conversion from the passenger-car slot.
Revalidate seats=20 because a maintenance conversion should prioritize equipment space.

entries.verdict: The Hadley's Hope vehicle is the Daihotai Tractor, commonly Colony Tractor. The film configuration is a large eight-wheel suspended rover with room for at least five, not a three-seat farm tractor.

sources.use: Exact vehicle identity and visual configuration.

strictInvariants.silhouette: Wide eight-wheel rover with four articulated twin-wheel bogies, high suspended central cabin, towing gear, and spotlights.
strictInvariants.proportions: Very broad stance relative to roughly 6.6 m length; cabin sits above/between wheel bogies and supports five or more occupants.
strictInvariants.sidePerspective: Right-facing orthographic side view showing four visible wheels/two paired bogie groups; cabin level and ground datum clear.
strictInvariants.metroidvania: Wheel-bogie articulation, elevated cabin, sealed door, tow point, and lights must read immediately.
strictInvariants.markings: Colonial utility wear and original Hadley's Hope/Daihotai-style service number; no copied film texture.

forbiddenRedesign: Do not depict a six-wheel novel-only variation when film fidelity is the target.
Do not turn it into a farm tractor with exposed driver.
Do not reuse the M577 body.
requiredCorrections: Rename to Daihotai Tractor / Colony Tractor.
Change seats from 3 to at least 5; document any higher gameplay capacity.

entries.verdict: A precise six-person reference exists: the roughly 8 m Weyland EVA-7C Series Pressure Pod, crew two plus four passengers, intended for deep underwater and gas-giant survey. Skiff is the wrong vehicle noun.

sources.use: Exact name, size, complement, manipulators, pods, sensors, and underwater role.

strictInvariants.silhouette: Compact sealed pressure pod with rounded pressure hull, thruster clusters, side storage/airlock pods, forward manipulators and digging tools.
strictInvariants.proportions: About 8 m long; two-crew control section plus four-passenger pressure volume; dense and pod-like, not long and boat-like.
strictInvariants.sidePerspective: Right-facing orthographic submerged profile, no water background; thrusters and manipulators fully inside canvas.
strictInvariants.metroidvania: Pressure hull, viewing/control area, airlock/storage modules, thrusters, and manipulators remain separately legible.
strictInvariants.markings: Weyland EVA hazard/depth markings and new pod serial; no copied book illustration decals.

forbiddenRedesign: Do not depict an open skiff, surface boat, or hydrofoil.
Do not add a submarine conning tower or military torpedoes.
Do not alter the six-person pressure-pod scale.
requiredCorrections: Rename to Weyland EVA-7C Series Pressure Pod.
Keep capacity 6 but record it as 2 crew plus 4 passengers.
Optionally refine family from maritime to submersible.

entries.verdict: No reliable Alien-franchise Ceto location/faction or exact patrol boat was located. The current licensed-continuity treatment is unsupported; Ceto is project continuity.

strictInvariants.silhouette: Low rugged eight-person patrol launch with enclosed wheelhouse, shallow armored bow, side fenders, stern drive, and practical boarding step.
strictInvariants.proportions: Compact working boat rather than yacht; wheelhouse occupies roughly the middle third and leaves readable bow/stern work areas.
strictInvariants.sidePerspective: Right-facing orthographic waterline profile on transparent alpha; straight water datum, no wake or sea background.
strictInvariants.metroidvania: Bow, wheelhouse, entry point, deck rail, and propulsion must read as traversal/boarding affordances.
strictInvariants.markings: Project-created Ceto maritime authority colors, emblem, and serial; no real coast-guard or franchise logo.

forbiddenRedesign: Do not label Ceto as licensed or canon.
Do not copy a real patrol-boat model or coast-guard livery.
Do not turn it into a luxury speedboat or military missile craft.
requiredCorrections: Change provenance from licensed-continuity/licensed-reference to project-original.
Document Ceto as a project location/faction before asset production.

entries.verdict: USS Tantalus is project continuity; no exact external vehicle reference exists. The design must be original while staying within utilitarian Alien retro-future grammar.

strictInvariants.silhouette: Compact six-person command VTOL with armored cockpit, short operations cabin, paired lift units, landing skids, and sensor mast.
strictInvariants.proportions: Cabin volume visibly supports six without approaching dropship scale; sensors outweigh weapons in visual hierarchy.
strictInvariants.sidePerspective: Right-facing orthographic landed/hover profile, no bank and no perspective-distorted wings.
strictInvariants.metroidvania: Cockpit, command cabin door, lift units, landing points, and sensor mast read at gameplay zoom.
strictInvariants.markings: Only project-created Tantalus task-force insignia, command stripe, and serial.

forbiddenRedesign: Do not present it as a canonical USCM craft.
Do not clone the Cheyenne, Bearcat, Covenant lander, or Star Wars skiff.
Do not overload it with weapons that contradict a command role.
requiredCorrections: Change provenance to project-original.
Keep all names, markings, and hull geometry original.

entries.verdict: Echo-9 is a project designation and no exact franchise bike was located. It must not be conflated with the documented XT-37 Stinger fast-attack vehicle.

strictInvariants.silhouette: Low two-person tandem reconnaissance bike with protective front cowl, exposed rear utility rack, long suspension, and two primary contact wheels.
strictInvariants.proportions: Human riders establish motorcycle scale; narrow cabin/cowl, long wheelbase, minimal armor, no car-width body.
strictInvariants.sidePerspective: Strict right-facing orthographic side profile, both wheels on one datum and steering angle neutral.
strictInvariants.metroidvania: Two seats, handlebar/control area, suspension, wheels, and compact sensor pack remain legible.
strictInvariants.markings: Project Echo-9 recon stripe, original serial, muted field-service paint.

forbiddenRedesign: Do not call it an XT-37 or copy the Stinger.
Do not add anti-gravity, a third wheel, or a closed car cabin.
Do not use modern commercial motorcycle branding.
requiredCorrections: Change provenance to project-original.
Define Echo-9 as project unit/location metadata.

entries.verdict: Aliens: Crucible was a cancelled Obsidian/SEGA project. No caravan crawler from it was verified. The runtime vehicle is original geometry adapting a non-canon production concept/name and must never be described as a recovered canonical chassis.

sources.use: Cancelled-project identity, setting, and non-release status.

strictInvariants.silhouette: Long ten-person survival crawler with segmented armored living module, multiple low track bogies, roof cargo, and repairable external systems.
strictInvariants.proportions: Caravan length and habitable volume dominate; low speed/terrain clearance, not tank stance; human-scale door and storage establish size.
strictInvariants.sidePerspective: Right-facing orthographic ground profile with all bogies aligned and full caravan body unclipped.
strictInvariants.metroidvania: Entry door, driver cab, module seams, roof cargo, ladder, and track units act as readable traversal landmarks.
strictInvariants.markings: Project-created Crucible survivor/caravan markings; no Obsidian, SEGA, or cancelled-game logo.

forbiddenRedesign: Do not claim that the exact vehicle appeared in Aliens: Crucible.
Do not reproduce leaked/cancelled concept art.
Do not convert it into an M577 or military main battle tank.
requiredCorrections: Change provenance to project adaptation from a cancelled, non-canon concept.
State explicitly that the chassis itself is project-original.

entries.verdict: Neuro-Xeno and the transport rig are project continuity. No exact external vehicle reference was located.

strictInvariants.silhouette: Heavy five-person containment tractor with sealed forward cab, central isolated specimen capsule, rear life-support/power module, and broad crawler tracks.
strictInvariants.proportions: Containment capsule is the visual center and remains smaller than the total vehicle; cab supports crew without becoming an APC troop bay.
strictInvariants.sidePerspective: Right-facing orthographic ground profile, full tracks and capsule visible, no obscuring three-quarter cage.
strictInvariants.metroidvania: Cab door, quarantine capsule, service ladder, external conduits, and rear module must be readable interaction zones.
strictInvariants.markings: Project quarantine chevrons, hazard class, Neuro-Xeno program code, and original serial.

forbiddenRedesign: Do not use a canonical company/model claim.
Do not copy the Alien Resurrection specimen cages or Jurassic Park transport design.
Do not expose the specimen without a sealed containment boundary.
requiredCorrections: Change provenance to project-original.
Keep Neuro-Xeno terminology explicitly within project continuity.

entries.recommendedName: Project USCM Assault Gunship, or select UD-4C/UD-22
entries.verdict: USCM Assault Gunship is a generic role, not a unique documented model. Canon options include gunship-configured Cheyenne variants such as UD-4C and other named craft; the project must select one or label an original chassis.

sources.use: Official licensed manual for named USCM aerospace craft.
Documents the UD-4C gunship configuration and Cheyenne variants.

strictInvariants.silhouette: If project-original: compact armored VTOL gunship with clear cockpit, lift/drive units, short assault cabin, and bounded weapon hardpoints; if UD-4C, preserve Cheyenne lineage.
strictInvariants.proportions: Weapons remain subordinate to a flyable airframe; eight-person gameplay capacity requires visible cabin volume and cannot be inferred from a fighter fuselage.
strictInvariants.sidePerspective: Right-facing orthographic landed/hover profile with gear and weapon arcs readable; no banking hero shot.
strictInvariants.metroidvania: Cockpit, cabin hatch, landing gear, propulsion, and each weapon family must separate at gameplay zoom.
strictInvariants.markings: USCM squadron grammar and original tail number; exact model designation only after selection.

forbiddenRedesign: Do not invent a silhouette and call it canon USCM.
Do not blend Bearcat, Cheyenne, and UPP Krokodil features.
Do not add more weapons than the selected model documents.
requiredCorrections: Select a named canon gunship model and align capacity, or retain the generic name as project adaptation.
Do not keep licensed-reference provenance for an unspecified chassis.

entries.recommendedName: Project 12-person Orbital Lifeboat, or Type 337 EEV
entries.verdict: Orbital Lifeboat is generic. The recognizable Alien 3 reference is the asymmetric Type 337 EEV, which carries five, not twelve. Retain 12 only for a clearly project-designed lifeboat.

sources.use: Exact EEV identity, asymmetric silhouette, dimensions, and five-person complement.

strictInvariants.silhouette: For Type 337: asymmetric L-shaped enclosed EEV with cryotube volume and docking collar; for project 12-person craft: visibly larger but still blunt emergency hardware.
strictInvariants.proportions: Type 337 is about 13.2 m and five-person scale; a twelve-person adaptation must gain cabin length/volume rather than merely relabel capacity.
strictInvariants.sidePerspective: Right-facing orthographic space profile with docking collar and reentry underside readable.
strictInvariants.metroidvania: Emergency hatch, docking collar, cabin/cryo volume, thrusters, and landing/recovery points remain distinct.
strictInvariants.markings: High-contrast emergency/rescue blocks and original unit number; no copied Sulaco EEV lettering.

forbiddenRedesign: Do not draw a Type 337 silhouette and claim twelve seats.
Do not turn a lifeboat into a luxury shuttle or fighter.
Do not symmetrize the Type 337 if that model is selected.
requiredCorrections: Choose Type 337 with capacity 5, or keep 12 and label/design a project adaptation.
Record the selected model before art.

entries.recommendedName: Project Colony Cargo Lifter, or Weyland-Yutani WY-37B Cargo Lifter Sled

entries.verdict: No released exact chassis was verified. An executive shuttle appears textually in William Gibson's unproduced Alien III draft, which is not canon and supplies no safe fixed screen silhouette.

Unproduced draft textual phrase only; explicitly not canon visual evidence.

strictInvariants.proportions: Cabin volume visibly supports ten; refinement comes from panel discipline, not implausibly thin luxury-jet proportions.
strictInvariants.sidePerspective: Right-facing orthographic landed/space profile; no glamour three-quarter presentation.
strictInvariants.metroidvania: Cockpit, passenger door, docking interface, engine modules, and gear remain strong gameplay landmarks.

entries.recommendedName: Project UPP Combat Aerodyne, or select Mi-220/UPP-DS3
entries.verdict: No exact UPP Combat Aerodyne was verified. Aerodyne names a separate light civilian VTOL gyrocar family with 5 published passengers, while UPP has named military craft such as Mi-220 Krokodil and UPP-DS3 Accipiter. These identities cannot be blended.

strictInvariants.silhouette: If retaining aerodyne: compact automotive VTOL/gyrocar with road-vehicle cabin and bounded lift units, not a full dropship; named UPP options follow their own silhouettes.
strictInvariants.proportions: Aerodyne remains about 5.2 m automotive scale with 5 published passengers; seats=6 is valid only if the runtime field counts one operator plus those five passengers. Krokodil/Accipiter scale must not leak into it.
strictInvariants.sidePerspective: Right-facing orthographic hover/landed profile with lift units and cabin baseline clear.
strictInvariants.metroidvania: Cockpit, cabin doors, lift units, gear/skids, sensors, and limited weapon mounts remain legible.
strictInvariants.markings: UPP muted grey/green and restrained red identification blocks, original Cyrillic-style serial without copied emblem art.

forbiddenRedesign: Do not combine civilian Aerodyne, Mi-220, and Accipiter geometry.
Do not use USCM Cheyenne markings.
Do not call the project vehicle canon without a model selection.
requiredCorrections: Choose a named UPP craft or retain Project UPP Combat Aerodyne as adaptation.
Document whether seats counts total occupants: keep seats=6 only as one operator plus the Aerodyne's 5 published passengers.

entries.verdict: Hyperdyne is attested as a synthetic manufacturer, but no exact Synthetic Carrier appears in its documented product set. The chassis is a project invention using a franchise corporation.

sources.use: Official film-continuity anchor for Hyperdyne synthetic references.
Product-list cross-check showing no carrier chassis.

strictInvariants.proportions: Transport/rack volume dominates; driver cab may be minimal because cargo is synthetic, but human-scale service access remains visible.
strictInvariants.sidePerspective: Right-facing orthographic ground profile with all contacts on one datum and rack doors unobscured.
strictInvariants.metroidvania: Control cab, rack bays, service panel, loading door, and mobility units form distinct interaction zones.
strictInvariants.markings: Hyperdyne-era corporate text grammar and original fleet serial; no invented official model badge.

forbiddenRedesign: Do not claim it is a documented Hyperdyne product.
Do not reuse the M577 APC silhouette.
Do not expose eight human-like bodies as decorative cargo.
requiredCorrections: Change provenance to project adaptation.

entries.verdict: Mining is common franchise context, but no exact named nine-seat Mining Bore Crawler was found. The chassis must be project-original rather than inferred from generic mining references.

strictInvariants.proportions: Bore diameter is large enough for an access tunnel but remains below total chassis height; cabin and machinery visibly account for nine crew.
strictInvariants.sidePerspective: Right-facing orthographic ground profile, boring head fully visible and tracks sharing one datum.
strictInvariants.metroidvania: Bore head, operator cabin, access ladder, conveyor, track units, and rear generator read as traversal/hazard landmarks.
strictInvariants.markings: Project mining consortium colors, hazard chevrons, and original equipment serial.

forbiddenRedesign: Do not label a generic drilling machine as a canon Alien model.
Do not copy a real tunnel-boring machine or another franchise's crawler.
Do not replace the bore with weapons.
requiredCorrections: Change provenance to project-original.
Define manufacturer/location in project lore before final markings.

entries.verdict: Atmosphere Processing Plants are documented infrastructure, but no exact 30-seat vehicle model was verified. This is a building-bound service elevator/cage, not an independent vehicle.

strictInvariants.proportions: Thirty-person freight/passenger capacity requires a large vertical cabin and wide doors; guide hardware establishes that it cannot travel independently.
strictInvariants.sidePerspective: Strict lateral orthographic elevation; cabin base aligned to a rail/shaft datum, no floating perspective.
strictInvariants.metroidvania: Door, control panel, roof cable/guide assembly, maintenance hatch, and shaft-contact rollers read as interaction points.
strictInvariants.markings: Atmosphere processor zone code, capacity plate, industrial hazard bars, and original car number.

forbiddenRedesign: Do not render it as a train, hovercraft, or flying elevator.

requiredCorrections: Reclassify in content as infrastructure/rail cabin rather than standalone vehicle where schema permits.
Change provenance to project adaptation.

entries.verdict: Towerlink passenger cars are documented on Sevastopol, but the searched material describes pressurized-tube transit, not a confirmed maglev model. Maglev is therefore an unsupported project technology label.

strictInvariants.sidePerspective: Right-facing orthographic rail/tube profile on one guide datum; no bullet-train perspective cone.
strictInvariants.metroidvania: Doors, windows, couplers, emergency hatch, undercarriage/guide interface, and destination panel read at sprite scale.
strictInvariants.markings: Project transit operator route blocks and original car number; use Seegson only if story ownership is explicit.

entries.verdict: No exact Alien-franchise Reef Hydrofoil was located. It belongs to the project's ocean-world continuity.

Use M40 Ridgeway Heavy Tank and crew 2–3, not seats 4.
